verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Isaac is a robotics simulation and development platform, not an agent itself, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server. The 'AI agent skill' for upgrading ROS 2 nodes and the 'agent-ready' description of Isaac Lab refer to adjacent features (a coding skill and RL training agents), not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.
